description:
On 6th November 2026, Annadaan Seva at Tata Memorial Hospital
A thoughtful gesture of love and compassion!
Rtn Brijmohan Seksaria organised a special lunch at Tata Memorial Hospital to celebrate the birthday of Sulochanaji, as per the Hindu calendar. A wholesome meal was served to 350 patients, comprising unlimited dal, rice, two vegetables, rotis and a sweet dish.
Beneficiaries: 350 patients
Project Cost: ₹18,000/-
